objective: Economic viability gate. A predictive signal is not considered usable unless its conservative expected payout exceeds the RM1 stake after prize mechanics, time value, model uncertainty, and payout-sharing/cap considerations.

distributionModel.type: fixed-size conditional Bernoulli / maximum-entropy 8-of-36 set model
distributionModel.note: Weights are fitted so the full 36-number marginal inclusion vector matches the blocked V5 research vector while every simulated/exact state contains exactly 8 main numbers. Bonus numbers are conditionally uniform among the 28 non-main numbers because no bonus-number edge is validated.

rules: pre-draw upstream probabilities beat uniform on locked Brier and log loss

nominal EV exceeds RM1 per RM1 stake
